name: Smart Drinks
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 2,650 experience instead of 1,350, 1.96 times as much. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well.  But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try!  And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!

There is a substance called Wailing Essence, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the Barrens.  Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!

I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west.  Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.
narrative.objectives: Bring 6 portions of Wailing Essence to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
narrative.offerRewardText: Great, you got it! I can't wait to try it out. This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!Thank you, adventurer. Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!
